# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 28 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth's Song of Thanksgiving

---

**1** I will praise the Lord God Most High — he heard me when I cried out to him. He noticed my humiliation and my suffering.

**2** He rescued me from the pit of death and from the traps of the evil one. He brought me up from darkness into light.

**3** He healed my wounds, gave me new life, and made me pure and whole.

**4** He lifted me out of my shame, covered me with his great mercy, and turned my weeping into joy.

**5** He gave me Joseph his servant as my husband and companion for all my journey.

**6** Blessed is the name of the Lord God Most High, who does wonders for those who love him.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
